# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK_PARAM_SWEEP_TOP_KEEPER

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** parameter change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK setup with specific parameters (vol_mult=1.3, body_min_cents=0.05, min_stars=2, strike_offset=2, premium_stop_pct=-0.08, tp1_premium_pct=0.4, runner_target_pct=1.5, profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.0, profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05, tp1_qty_fraction=0.667, qty=10, proximity_dollars=1.5, require_break_above_open=true) captures edge by identifying strong level breaks with volume confirmation and avoiding premature exits via wide profit-lock settings. The edge exists because level breaks with institutional volume (vol_mult>1) and minimal body rejection (body_min_cents>0) signal genuine institutional participation, while the wide tp1_premium_pct (0.4) and runner_target_pct (1.5) allow runners to develop in trending markets.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers when: (1) price breaks a named level (horizontal or trendline) by proximity_dollars ($1.50), (2) volume exceeds vol_mult (1.3x) of 20-bar average, (3) candle body exceeds body_min_cents ($0.05) in the break direction, (4) minimum star rating (min_stars=2) based on confluence with multi-day structure and VIX regime, (5) for put breaks, require_break_above_open=true ensures breakdown below open. Exit uses: premium_stop_pct=-0.08 (8% catastrophe cap), tp1_premium_pct=0.4 (40% TP1 on 66.7% of position), runner_target_pct=1.5 (150% runner target), profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.0 (no profit-lock arming), profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.05 (5% trailing stop once runner target approached). Quantity fixed at 10 contracts.
